title: Linear inequalities for the partition function from truncated pentagonal series
statement:
Let $A(n)$ denote the partition function introduced in the paper, and let $\delta(n)$ denote the quantity appearing in the source. For an integer $k>0$, define the finite alternating sum over $j=-(k-1),\ldots,k$ using the generalized pentagonal shifts $j(3j-1)/2$. **The partition-function inequality conjecture.** For all relevant integers $n$,

$$
(-1)^{k-1}\left(\sum_{j=-(k-1)}^k(-1)^j A\bigl(n-j(3j-1)/2\bigr)-\delta(n)\right)\geq 0,
$$

with strict inequality if $n=k(3k+1)/2$ or $n\geq k(3k+1)/2+2$. This is stated as an immediate consequence conditional on the preceding strengthened positivity conjecture, so its status is likewise unresolved.
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/1912.04658

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of December 2019).
source_name: Christian Krattenthaler, Mircea Merca and Cristian-Silviu Radu, “Infinite product formulae for generating functions for sequences of squares”, arXiv:1912.04658 (2021).
